# Deferred authentication providers

This is a synthetic requirement fixture based on the approved affected-area map,
not a copy of a private source or a provider verification report.

## Facebook
### Blocker
Provider readiness is unverified: app configuration, email permission, provider
credentials, redirect allowlist and an accepted execution plan must be evidenced.
The disabled registry entry, translated button, and shared OAuth path already
exist. They do not establish a successful provider login.
### Account and acceptance requirements
Phone before email; email never grants merchant approval. Check existing account
linking, cancellation, denied permission, absent email, callback errors, session
persistence, sign-out, locale behavior and Mobile Safari. Preserve tested revision,
environment, attributed result and file-content evidence.
